title: Streamlit usage statistics are on
explanation: Streamlit's browser.gatherUsageStats defaults to true, so the app's browser client sends usage statistics to Streamlit. It's off only when a config.toml sets it to false (or the matching STREAMLIT_ environment variable does).

evidence.detail: streamlit 1.40.0 installed; not disabled in the image (none of STREAMLIT_BROWSER_GATHER_USAGE_STATS=0|false|no|off); no matching config file

fix: Add "[browser] gatherUsageStats = false" to .streamlit/config.toml in the image.
